name: Granite & Marbles
intro: Granite and marble slabs from our yard for kitchen countertops, flooring, staircases and cladding, plus granite engraving, stone furniture and name boards cut to order. Every slab is different, so ask us for photos of what is in the yard today.
heroAlt: Black granite slab with bold white veins in our slab yard
